card.title: How To Fix iPhone 7 That Is Stuck Always Searching or No Service After Audio IC Repair Attempt

source.title: How To Fix iPhone 7 That Is Stuck Always Searching or No Service After Audio IC Repair Attempt

symptoms: no service after audio IC repair

claims.statement: No service / no IMEI after an audio IC repair attempt usually means excess heat floated the underfilled baseband CPU; reballing the baseband PMU first is also worth trying.
Reballing the baseband CPU next to the main CPU is high risk; afterwards flash an update rather than restoring.

procedure: Reball the baseband CPU if needed.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Too much heat on the audio IC can disturb the baseband CPU and main CPU.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
